title: Ballerina Cappuccina
blurb: Ballerina Cappuccina — a ballerina with a cappuccino cup for a head, because the Italian brainrot universe follows dream logic exclusively. She's one of the genre's most-shared characters, and the sing-song delivery of her name is a large part of why. Coffee, dance, and absolute nonsense, in perfect harmony.
origin: An Italian brainrot AI character — the coffee-cup ballerina.
